node:experience.label: Customer experience
node:experience.responsibility: Browse products, maintain shopping state and submit checkout requests securely.

node:shopping.label: Shopping & sessions
node:shopping.responsibility: Handle storefront interactions and short-lived shopping state.

node:storefront.label: Storefront

node:bff.label: Storefront API
node:bff.responsibility: Combine order and stock information, validate sessions and forward checkout requests.

node:session.label: Session cache
node:session.responsibility: Store expiring cart and session references without payment card numbers.

node:checkout.label: Checkout
node:checkout.responsibility: Collect delivery and payment choices; coordinate stock, risk and payment.

node:cart_ui.label: Checkout page
node:cart_ui.responsibility: Show purchase and delivery options; submit checkout after customer confirmation.

node:checkout_api.label: Checkout service

node:fraud_rules.label: Risk rules

node:transactions.label: Orders & payments

node:orders.label: Order management

node:order_service.label: Order service

node:order_db.responsibility: Store order items, delivery details and state versions with idempotent creation.

node:order_outbox.label: Order outbox
node:order_outbox.responsibility: Read transactionally recorded events, retry delivery and track publication progress.

node:payments.label: Payment processing
node:payments.responsibility: Isolate the payment provider and retain authorization and refund audit records.

node:payment_router.label: Payment router
node:payment_router.responsibility: Request authorizations and refunds, validate callbacks and report payment outcomes.

node:payment_ledger.label: Payment ledger
node:payment_ledger.responsibility: Record payment identifiers, authorizations, refunds and reconciliation differences.

node:psp.label: Payment provider

node:fulfillment.label: Inventory & fulfillment
node:fulfillment.responsibility: Turn paid orders into traceable picking, shipping and delivery workflows.

node:inventory.label: Stock & picking
node:inventory.responsibility: Maintain available quantities and warehouse picking outcomes.

node:stock_service.label: Inventory service
node:stock_service.responsibility: Atomically reserve and release stock; coordinate picking and report shortages.

node:shipping.label: Delivery coordination
node:shipping.responsibility: Arrange carriers and normalize delivery progress.

node:shipping_service.label: Shipping service
node:shipping_service.responsibility: Consume eligible orders and create shipments after picking completes.

node:carrier.label: Carrier network
node:carrier.responsibility: Accept shipment details and report pickup, transit and delivery.

node:delivery_events.label: Delivery webhooks
node:delivery_events.responsibility: Verify and deduplicate carrier callbacks into standard delivery events.

node:platform.responsibility: Share reliable business events, customer notifications and observability.

node:messaging.label: Events & notifications
node:messaging.responsibility: Distribute business state changes and notify customers.

node:event_bus.label: Business event bus
node:event_bus.responsibility: Partition and distribute payment, picking and delivery events by order.

node:notification.label: Notification service
node:notification.responsibility: Select templates, deduplicate and schedule customer notifications.

node:email.label: Email provider
node:email.responsibility: Send transactional email and report delivery or bounce outcomes.

node:operations.responsibility: Combine service signals and surface payment and fulfillment anomalies.

node:telemetry.responsibility: Collect checkout, payment and shipping traces and metrics; remove sensitive data.

node:metrics.label: Metrics store
node:metrics.responsibility: Store success rates, authorization latency and fulfillment backlog time series.

node:alerts.label: Alert service
node:alerts.responsibility: Query metrics and escalate delayed payments, shortages and delivery anomalies.

node:idp.label: Enterprise identity

node:project.label: Projects & documents

node:project_api.label: Project service
node:project_api.responsibility: Manage members, tasks and file indexes while enforcing tenant isolation.

node:metadata_db.label: Project database
node:metadata_db.responsibility: Store authoritative project, role, task and document metadata versions.

node:activity_bus.label: Activity event bus
node:activity_bus.responsibility: Partition task, document and AI job state changes by project.

node:editor.label: Document editor
node:editor.responsibility: Show shared documents, cursors and revision hints; submit edits and receive remote changes.

node:document_service.label: Document service
node:document_service.responsibility: Authorize documents, merge edits and preserve traceable revisions.

node:doc_store.label: Document storage
node:doc_store.responsibility: Store snapshots, operations and authorized attachments for restore and knowledge indexing.

node:realtime.label: Realtime sync
node:realtime.responsibility: Deliver accepted updates to collaborators who are currently online.

node:sync_service.label: Sync & presence
node:sync_service.responsibility: Distribute versioned activity updates and manage expiring connection, cursor and subscription leases.

node:websocket.label: Realtime gateway
node:websocket.responsibility: Maintain authenticated bidirectional connections for edits, cursors and job progress.

node:ai.label: AI orchestration

node:jobs.label: Scheduling & governance

node:job_api.label: AI job API
node:job_api.responsibility: Accept instructions and explicit context; create job identities and expose progress.

node:job_queue.label: Job queue
node:job_queue.responsibility: Reliably retain pending jobs, retry counts and cancellation signals.

node:scheduler.label: Job scheduler
node:scheduler.responsibility: Dispatch jobs by quota, tenant and state while preventing duplicate execution.

node:policy_engine.label: Policy engine
node:policy_engine.responsibility: Evaluate tenant, data classification and action risk to allow, block or request review.

node:approval_service.label: Human review
node:approval_service.responsibility: Hold pending proposals and record authenticated decisions before releasing approved steps.

node:run_store.label: Run evidence store
node:run_store.responsibility: Preserve job state, context versions, tool results, provider usage and review links.

node:execution.label: Controlled execution
node:execution.responsibility: Run agents, authorized tools and external model requests.

node:agent_worker.label: Agent worker
node:agent_worker.responsibility: Execute work using authorized context and record tool results and actual model usage.

node:tool_gateway.label: Tool gateway
node:tool_gateway.responsibility: Validate each tool call's scope and permission before forwarding project or document actions.

node:model_gateway.label: Model provider
node:model_gateway.responsibility: Receive approved prompts and return model output with actual provider usage.

node:data.label: Knowledge & analytics
node:data.responsibility: Turn documents into searchable knowledge and project usage analytics.

node:ingest.label: Knowledge ingestion
node:ingest.responsibility: Read accepted revisions, chunk content and synchronize search and source attachments.

node:vector_index.label: Vector index
node:vector_index.responsibility: Store searchable content and citations with tenant, document permission and version boundaries.

node:stream_processor.label: Activity processor
node:stream_processor.responsibility: Deduplicate collaboration and job events and calculate tenant aggregates.

node:analytics_warehouse.label: Analytics warehouse
node:analytics_warehouse.responsibility: Store anonymized activity, job duration and model usage reporting data.

node:report_api.label: Reporting API
node:report_api.responsibility: Return tenant usage trends, job success rates and cost summaries by period.

node:trust.label: Trust & operations
node:trust.responsibility: Provide cross-service telemetry, immutable audits and protected keys.

node:otel.label: Telemetry & alerts
node:otel.responsibility: Collect redacted gateway, sync and agent signals; detect abnormal usage and publish workspace alerts.

node:metrics.label: Service metrics
node:metrics.responsibility: Store error rates, queue waits, sync latency and model usage metrics.

node:audit_writer.label: Audit writer
node:audit_writer.responsibility: Append request-linked sign-in, tool authorization and human review events.

node:audit_store.label: Immutable audit log
node:audit_store.responsibility: Retain tenant actions, review decisions and integrity digests under retention policy.

node:key_store.label: Key management
node:key_store.responsibility: Provide permission-controlled, rotated encryption, signing and service credential references.

node:business.label: Product & demand
node:business.responsibility: Turn customer orders, engineering definitions and forecasts into manufacturing inputs.

node:order_intake.label: Customer orders
node:order_intake.responsibility: Validate customers and product revisions, accept quantity and due-date requirements, and report progress.

node:order_book.label: Order book
node:order_book.responsibility: Store quantities, promised dates, product revisions and delivery status.

node:bom_service.label: Product engineering
node:bom_service.responsibility: Resolve revisions, BOM quantities and substitutions; author controlled engineering changes.

node:revision_store.label: Engineering revisions
node:revision_store.responsibility: Retain accepted product versions, process definitions and BOM snapshots.

node:forecast_engine.label: Demand planning
node:forecast_engine.responsibility: Combine orders and delivery history into versioned period demand; review forecast differences.

node:demand_store.label: Demand plans
node:demand_store.responsibility: Store confirmed demand versions, periods and product quantities.

node:planning.label: Supply & production
node:planning.responsibility: Turn demand, supply conditions and capacity constraints into purchasing and production plans.

node:mrp.label: Material planning
node:mrp.responsibility: Calculate net demand, shortages and substitutions; create traceable, deduplicated purchase requirements.

node:material_plan.label: Material plans
node:material_plan.responsibility: Store calculation versions, net demand, expected arrivals and shortages.

node:procurement.label: Procurement
node:procurement.responsibility: Coordinate purchase requests, supplier commitments, shipment notices and supply exceptions with ERP.

node:erp.label: Enterprise ERP
node:erp.responsibility: Maintain official purchase orders, suppliers, financial postings and delivery commitments.

node:scheduler.label: Production scheduler
node:scheduler.responsibility: Solve material, equipment, changeover and due-date constraints; publish versioned production sequences.

node:production_plan.label: Production plans
node:production_plan.responsibility: Store accepted batch sequences, stations, time windows and plan versions.

node:factory.label: Factory & quality
node:factory.responsibility: Translate schedules into work orders, equipment tasks and traceable quality outcomes.

node:mes_dispatch.label: Manufacturing execution
node:mes_dispatch.responsibility: Create work orders and operator instructions; dispatch tasks and collect quantity, duration and exception results.

node:work_order.label: Work orders
node:work_order.responsibility: Store batches, operations, material lots, actual results and work-order versions.

node:edge_gateway.label: Factory edge gateway
node:edge_gateway.responsibility: Map work orders to equipment tasks, collect status and isolate factory connections from the platform.

node:plc.label: Line & robot control
node:plc.responsibility: Execute local equipment sequences and robot tasks with interlocks; report cycles, completion and faults.

node:quality_gate.label: Quality inspection
node:quality_gate.responsibility: Combine vision and process evidence to release, rework or quarantine batches.

node:quality_store.label: Quality records
node:quality_store.responsibility: Preserve lot identifiers, inspection evidence, release outcomes and rework links.

node:logistics.label: Warehouse & logistics
node:logistics.responsibility: Receive materials, replenish production lines and deliver released finished goods.

node:wms.label: Warehouse service
node:wms.responsibility: Manage receipt, locations, reservations and dispatch; reconcile arrivals and record material lots.

node:inventory_ledger.label: Lot inventory ledger
node:inventory_ledger.responsibility: Track material and finished-goods lots, locations, reservations and movements.

node:agv_controller.label: Material transport
node:agv_controller.responsibility: Coordinate approved vehicle tasks and line delivery; track location, loads and completion.

node:line_buffer.label: Lineside inventory
node:line_buffer.responsibility: Store station arrivals, replenishment needs and material-lot usage.

node:shipping.label: Outbound shipping
node:shipping.responsibility: Verify release and due dates, arrange picking and carrier routes, and update customer orders.

node:carrier.label: Logistics carriers
node:carrier.responsibility: Accept finished-goods transport and report pickup, transit and delivery.

node:digital.label: Industrial data & twin
node:digital.responsibility: Combine factory facts into equipment state, simulation and traceability analytics.

node:stream_ingest.label: Industrial event pipeline
node:stream_ingest.responsibility: Validate device identity, time and sequence; deduplicate equipment, work-order and quality facts with source versions.

node:twin_engine.label: Asset digital twin
node:twin_engine.responsibility: Map process events to equipment and line state; retain asset identity, station relationships and capability versions.

node:simulation.label: Capacity simulation
node:simulation.responsibility: Evaluate bottlenecks and changeovers against equipment state for scheduling decisions.

node:data_lake.label: Industrial data platform
node:data_lake.responsibility: Store partitioned process time series and production and quality analytics with source identity and retention.

node:bi.label: Manufacturing analytics
node:bi.responsibility: Explore yield, delivery, equipment efficiency and shortages back to original lots.

node:operations.label: Device trust & operations
node:operations.responsibility: Connect independent device identity, local safety and platform monitoring responsibilities.

node:device_identity.label: Device identity
node:device_identity.responsibility: Verify device registration, leases and revocation; issue and rotate device certificates.

node:key_vault.label: Factory key vault
node:key_vault.responsibility: Protect signing keys and provide auditable device-trust cryptographic operations.

node:interlock.label: Local safety interlock
node:interlock.responsibility: Execute predefined interlocks on locally certified safety equipment, independently of cloud analytics.

node:incident.label: Safety & incidents
node:incident.responsibility: Collect safety signals, retain owners and recovery conditions, and notify manufacturing execution.

node:telemetry.label: Operations telemetry
node:telemetry.responsibility: Collect service signals, track errors and backlog, and create source-linked incidents for threshold breaches.
